title: Expanded circuit encoding
statement: For a directed acyclic Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input vertices with output vertex $o$, its Boolean-string encoding is the concatenation of $n$ true bits followed by a false bit, the encoded gate list, and $o$ true bits followed by a false bit.
hypotheses_covered: A directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices
